fields.name: pos
fields.evidence: pos slot (vtable 0x60) returns this+0x30; pos_x/y/z exports call it then load f32 at +0/+4/+8; pos_2d loads the xy pair; set_pos stores (x,y,z,0) and notifies ModelModule (boma+0x78, its slot 0x120) only when the value changed; add_pos = set_pos(pos+v); add_pos_2d = add_pos((x,y,0)); constructor zeroes it

fields.name: pos_x
fields.evidence: pos_x export: pos() then f32 at +0

fields.name: pos_y
fields.evidence: pos_y export: pos() then f32 at +4

fields.name: pos_z
fields.evidence: pos_z export: pos() then f32 at +8

fields.name: prev_pos
fields.evidence: prev_pos slot (0x90) returns this+0x40; prev_pos_2d loads its xy; vtable slot 0x158 copies pos->prev_pos (w=0) and every rot entry's rot (+0x10) to its prev rot (+0x20); init_pos writes pos, prev_pos and 0x50 at once

fields.name: saved_pos (restore point for interpolation)
fields.evidence: vtable slot 0x160 stores the current pos here, rewinds pos to prev_pos and stores pos-prev_pos into 0x60; slot 0x168 restores pos from here when the 0x70 flag is set; init_pos also writes it

fields.name: pos_delta (saved pos - prev_pos)
fields.how: computed by slot 0x160: saved pos minus prev_pos, w=0
fields.evidence: slot 0x170 (arg f32 t) sets pos = pos + delta*t and, per rot entry, rot = rot + rot_delta*t; zeroed by the constructor

fields.name: pos_changed (pos differed from prev_pos at slot 0x160)
fields.how: computed: not all three components equal
fields.evidence: slot 0x160 writes it; slots 0x168/0x170 test it (with the per-entry flags) to decide whether to notify ModelModule; constructor 0

fields.name: start_pos (position given at reset)
fields.how: no exported getter; vtable slot 0xA0 returns this+0x80, slot 0xA8 stores (x,y,z,0)
fields.evidence: vtable slot 0x38 (reset: init_pos, set_lr, init_scale, init_rot, init_rot_y_lr, set_owner_scale(1), link_scale=1, 0xC8=0, notify ModelModule) ends by storing its position argument here

fields.name: rot_count (number of rotation entries)
fields.evidence: init_rot loops i<count calling init_rot_2(i); init_rot_2 and set_rot bounds-check the index against it; slot 0x28 copies a 16-byte descriptor {count, array ptr} from its argument into 0x90..0x9F; constructor 0

fields.name: rot_entries (array of 0x60-byte rotation entries)
fields.evidence: rot/set_rot/init_rot_2 index ld64(this+0x98) + i*0x60

fields.name: rot[i]
fields.how: returns pointer to entry+0x10, no bounds check (rot_x/rot_y/rot_z load +0/+4/+8)
fields.evidence: rot slot (0xD8) returns ld64(this+0x98)+i*0x60+0x10; set_rot(v,i) bounds-checked against 0x90, stores (x,y,z,0) and notifies ModelModule slot 0x118 if changed; init_rot_2(i) writes a global constant vector (through pointer 0x71052A8A88, likely zero) into entry +0x10, +0x20 and +0x30 then notifies

fields.name: rot_entry.prev_rot
fields.evidence: slots 0x158 and 0x190 copy +0x10 into +0x20; slot 0x160 rewinds +0x10 from +0x20

fields.name: rot_entry.saved_rot
fields.evidence: slot 0x160 saves the current rot here; slot 0x168 restores rot from here if the entry flag is set

fields.name: rot_entry.rot_delta
fields.evidence: slot 0x160 writes; slot 0x170 adds rot_delta*t to rot

fields.name: rot_entry.changed
fields.evidence: slot 0x160 writes; 0x168/0x170 read

fields.name: base_scale
fields.evidence: base_scale slot (0x110) loads f32 +0xA0; set_scale(f, b) (slot 0x120) stores it if different, notifies ModelModule slot 0x118, and if b is false calls own scale() and LinkModule (boma+0xD0) slot 0x208(0); constructor 1.0

fields.name: scale_status
fields.evidence: set_scale_status (slot 0x130) stores it raw; slot 0x128 loads it; scale() multiplies by it; init_scale sets 1.0; slot 0x198 resets it to 1.0; constructor 1.0

fields.name: scale_sent_to_links (last base_scale pushed by set_scale(...,true))
fields.evidence: set_scale with bool true: if the value differs from this field, sends event 0x2E with the value, calls LinkModule slot 0x208(1), then stores it; init_scale sets 1.0; constructor 1.0

fields.name: lr
fields.evidence: lr slot (0xB0) loads f32 +0xAC; set_lr stores if different, sends event 0xA via LinkModule (boma+0xD0) and calls the module at boma+0x48 slot 0x390 with the new lr; reverse_lr = set_lr(-lr); set_stick_lr reads stick x from the boma+0x48 module (slot 0x178) and calls set_lr(+1/-1) when the stick exceeds +/- the argument, returns whether lr changed; constructor 0.0

fields.name: rot_y_lr
fields.evidence: rot_y_lr slot (0xF8) loads +0xB0; update_rot_y_lr sets it to lr*90.0 when different (notifies ModelModule, event 0x2A); init_rot_y_lr sets 0 if not 0 then calls update_rot_y_lr; reverse_rot_y_lr negates; is_rot_y_lr_different_inner_lr returns rot_y_lr != (lr==1 ? 90.0 : -90.0) via a table {-90,90}; constructor 0.0

fields.name: owner_scale
fields.evidence: owner_scale slot (0x140) loads +0xB4; set_owner_scale stores if different, notifies ModelModule, calls own scale() and LinkModule slot 0x208(0); constructor 1.0

fields.name: link_scale
fields.evidence: set_link_scale(f, b) (slot 0x150) mirrors set_scale on this field; reset (slot 0x38) sets 1.0; used by scale(); constructor 1.0

fields.name: link_scale_sent_to_links
fields.evidence: set_link_scale with bool true: sends event 0x2E then stores; init_scale sets 1.0; constructor 1.0

fields.name: sync_constraint_joint
fields.evidence: set_sync_constraint_joint (slot 0x180) stores the hash40; slot 0x188 compares its low 40 bits to a joint hash and, on match, calls set_pos with the translation (+0x30) of the passed transform; constructor and slot 0x198 set hash40("invalid") (0x07FB997A80, ParamLabels)

fields.name: ignore_link_scale (scale uses owner_scale instead of link_scale)
fields.how: no getter; set by vtable slot 0x1E0 (arg & 1)
fields.evidence: scale(): if this byte is set or link_scale == 1.0, scale = base_scale*owner_scale*scale_status, else base_scale*link_scale*scale_status; reset clears it; constructor 0

fields.name: flags (bitmask)
fields.how: no exported getter; vtable slot 0x1A0 ORs bits, 0x1A8 clears bits, 0x1B0 zeroes 0x18..0x1F, 0x1B8 tests a mask
fields.evidence: slot 0x1B8 returns 0 while the counter at 0x1C is > 0, else (flags & mask) != 0; constructor zeroes 0x18..0x1F

fields.name: flag_suspend_counter
fields.evidence: slot 0x1C8 increments, 0x1D0 decrements without going below 0
